description: Box à vélos à Lille, Lomme et Hellemmes is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Lille. Lists the location of bike boxes in Lille, Lomme and Hellemmes, as well as the number of places available in each box. The number indicated corresponds to the total places in the box, and not to the places available for allocation. Coverage: Ville de Lille. The portal shows the English title as "Bike boxes in Lille, Lomme and Hellemmes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Lille. Its keywords include velo, mobilite. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
